gloss: to state; to assert; to lodge (a complaint, objection)

definitions.gloss: to state; to assert; to lodge (a complaint, objection); to file
definitions.explanation: To formally state or put forward something — an opinion, complaint, objection, or claim — to an authority or in an official setting. Compound of {申|もう}す (humble "to say") + {立|た}てる (to put forward). Used in legal, administrative, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{異議|いぎ}→異議：13552_igi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{申|もう}し{立|た}てる。
⟦{被告人|ひこくにん}→被告人：20130_hikokunin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無罪|むざい}→無罪：13383_muzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{申|もう}し{立|た}てた。

⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不服|ふふく}→不服：19607_fufuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧、{二週間以内|にしゅうかんいない}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{控訴|こうそ}→控訴：05966_kouso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{申|もう}し{立|た}てる⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you are dissatisfied with the judgment, you need to lodge an appeal within two weeks.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{申|もう}す→申す：01319_mousu⟧ (humble form of "to say") + ⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ ("to set up, put forward"). The verb has a formal, often legal or administrative tone — not used for casual statements.

TRANSITIVITY: Transitive. The thing being asserted takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{申|もう}し{立|た}てる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{異議|いぎ}→異議：13552_igi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{申|もう}し{立|た}てる: to raise an objection
- ⟦{不服|ふふく}→不服：19607_fufuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{申|もう}し{立|た}てる: to file a complaint of dissatisfaction
- ⟦{無罪|むざい}→無罪：13383_muzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{申|もう}し{立|た}てる: to plead not guilty
- ⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{申|もう}し{立|た}てる: to assert a right
- ⟦{控訴|こうそ}→控訴：05966_kouso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{申|もう}し{立|た}てる: to lodge an appeal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{主張|しゅちょう}する→主張する：25380_shuchousuru⟧: to assert; to claim — broader, everyday register
- ⟦{申|もう}し{出|で}る→申し出る：10465_moushideru⟧: to come forward to say; to offer/propose — more for volunteering information or requests; less adversarial
